title: Entertaining mysteries
text:
A great free tour that is enjoyable with the guide (Maria N), she immerses you in the mysteries she tells and you get fully involved in the history.

Highly recommended.

title: Entertaining and exciting
text: The tour was exciting, we went with a group of 13 children and 2 adults because it was my son's birthday and they had a great time. Maria was charming and managed to keep the children attentive throughout the entire circuit. Guide 100% recommended, but I must report that our reservation made with Viator had not reached the operator and they were not aware of it despite having made it more than 15 days in advance, luckily Maria understood the situation and gave us the tour along with another group that did have the reservation made with another intermediary platform.
